name: plugg
tagline: melodic, minimal, and it sounds like a video game save screen
description: Spacious trap built on twinkling synths, sparse 808s and a laid-back bounce, born from producers like MexikoDro and StoopidXool's BeatPluggz crew in the mid-2010s. Pi'erre Bourne took the feel mainstream; the underground kept splitting it into pluggnb and dark plugg.
